notes.title: New Demo version 0.1.7 and Remote Play Together activated!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! We hope you all are great[/p][p]We are happy to share that we have been working hard on improving the [b]Castlebound[/b] Demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544519/e3805dfac905efc20c2f3b5a4607f10fa2472a97.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Latest v0.1.7 has the following upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]Player controller improved![/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay is more fun (more enemies coming)![/p][/*][*][p]Now it is easy to add/remove players for Multiplayer mode[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bugs and improvements![/p][/*][/list][p]*The game works great on Steam Deck[/p][p][b]We have also enabled the Remote Play Together feature on Steam and it works great![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It is better to play with game controllers and there is no need for all the players who are playing through Remote Player Together to have the demo installed. Only the host has to have the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue working on the Demo so please keep updating it.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Greetings![/p][p][/p][p]Steve[/p][p]Ogre Pixel[/p][p][url="https://ogrepixel.com"]www.ogrepixel.com[/url][/p]
